purpose: Teach finance basics; teach 証券/金利/不動産/所有/請求/保証/供給/兆

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今日は資産形成の基本をお話しします。
lines.en: Today I’ll cover the basics of building assets.
lines.style: approachable speaker opening the session, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 証券って、初心者には難しそうです。
lines.style: hesitant attendee voicing a worry, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 少額から始められますよ。金利の知識も役立ちます。
lines.en: You can start small. Knowing about interest rates helps too.
lines.style: encouraging speaker lowering the barrier, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 不動産を所有するのは、まだ先の話かな。
lines.en: Owning real estate is still far off for me.
lines.style: realistic attendee gauging her stage, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 早めに学べば、将来の請求や支払いにも備えられます。
lines.en: Learning early prepares you for future bills and payments.
lines.style: speaker stressing the value of foresight

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 保証や保険の仕組みも知りたいです。
lines.en: I want to understand guarantees and insurance too.
lines.style: eager attendee expanding her interest, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 需要と供給の関係を理解するのが第一歩です。
lines.en: Understanding supply and demand is the first step.
lines.style: speaker laying a foundational concept, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お金の世界って、何兆円も動くんですね。
lines.en: The world of money moves in the trillions, huh.
lines.style: awed attendee grasping the scale, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
